title: Bolivar Community Blood Drive
seo_title: Bolivar Community Blood Drive on Dec 17, 2026
description: This is a Community Blood Center of the Ozarks blood drive where you can donate blood; walk-ins are welcome, but appointments are encouraged and can be made by calling 417-227-5006. Donors need to bring photo identification, and successful donors in November and December receive a Kansas City Chiefs long-sleeve T-shirt while supplies last and are entered to win a Chiefs Tailgate Prize Package. It takes place December 17, 2026 (Time TBD) at 1220 S Springfield Ave in Bolivar, MO.
